name: Sharpshooter
desc: +1 Dexterity. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, you have no Disadvantage at long range or when attacking within 5 feet of an enemy, and your ranged weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

effects.note: Ranged weapons: ignore Half / Three-Quarters Cover, no Disadvantage at long range or in melee
